info.title: epac Backend API
info.description: Public and app-facing endpoints for the epac civic data backend. All civic data originates from authoritative government sources and backend records preserve source identifiers where available.

tags.description: Office of the Commissioner of Lobbying records mapped to epac topics.

get.summary: List ministerial travel and hospitality disclosures for a cabinet minister
get.description: Returns ministerial travel and hospitality expense records for the given member ID, sourced from Treasury Board Secretariat proactive disclosure pages. Only populated for current or past cabinet ministers. Records cover the most recent 4 fiscal quarters. All data originates from official TBS department proactive disclosure publications.

parameters.name: fiscal_year
parameters.description: Filter by fiscal year label, e.g. '2024-2025'.

parameters.name: quarter
parameters.description: Filter by fiscal quarter (1–4).

200.description: List of ministerial expense records for the member

records.event_purpose: G7 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting

get.description: Returns simplified GeoJSON for a 2023 Representation Order federal electoral district from the published riding boundary artifact.

get.summary: Return app configuration and feature flags
List prior-year Parliament moments from the same calendar day
get.description: Returns ranked Hansard speech records from earlier years on the same month and day from the published on-this-day artifact. Ranking is computed when the artifact is published.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Reference date in Ottawa-local calendar form.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 5 and caps at 20.

get.summary: Search Hansard interventions
get.description: Queries the published Hansard SQLite FTS5 index and returns paginated message hits with inline match snippets.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query. Trimmed input must be non-empty and at most 200 characters.

parameters.name: speaker
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive speaker-name filter.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive intervention topic filter.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page.

get.description: Returns paged Office of the Commissioner of Lobbying communication reports and registrations whose OCL subject-matter codes are mapped to the requested epac topic slug.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Stable epac topic slug.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Defaults to 50 and caps at 200.

200.description: Paged lobbying records for the topic

get.summary: Group a cabinet minister's lobbying communications by portfolio period
get.description: Returns Office of the Commissioner of Lobbying communication reports for one cabinet minister, grouped by minister portfolio periods. When portfolio boundaries are incomplete, the response falls back to a cabinet-tenure group and records a portfolio_boundary_gap warning.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: Hansard Affiliation DbId for the cabinet minister.

get.summary: List federal grants and contributions
get.description: Returns federal grants and contributions from Treasury Board Secretariat Proactive Disclosure. Source: https://open.canada.ca/data/en/dataset/432527ab-7aac-45b5-81d6-7597107a7013

parameters.name: fiscal_year
parameters.description: Filter by fiscal year (e.g. 2024-2025). Defaults to current + prior fiscal year.

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Filter by recipient province or territory (English name).

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Filter by awarding department name (partial match).

parameters.name: recipient_type
parameters.description: Filter by recipient type (e.g. Non-profit organization, Post-secondary institution).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search across recipient name, purpose, and department.

200.description: Paginated list of grants and contributions
